tracks.title: Past Interview Questions
tracks.subtitle: Glencore and Millennium × AmplifyME screens in one bank, ranked from easiest to most challenging
tracks.intro: Every retained question from both screens, ranked together by actual difficulty (level 1 → 5). The source of each question is shown as a badge; filter by source if you want, but the default view is the global ranking.

tracks.title: Quantitative Methods
tracks.subtitle: Four commodity-desk situations — Gas & Power, Oil Products, Crude: a trader's question, imperfect data, and an answer you can defend
tracks.intro: Each project starts with a trader's question and a deliberately imperfect synthetic dataset. Inside a project the steps go from knowing how to code (level 1) to knowing how to work on a desk (level 2): load and clean, analyse, test, then answer the trader. Charts are drawn by the Test code pads. All data are simulated with fixed seeds and never presented as market observations. Training projects inspired by commodity-desk work, not actual interview questions or internal methodologies of any firm.
